botupdates.description: Collect Sick-Cogs and configured public GitHub upstream changes into scheduled review drafts, accept trusted human edits, require final approval, and publish to subscribed servers.

polymarket.description: Develop-only CryptoWallet connector with protected, default-off Polymarket trading workflows.

author: SickProdigy
windrose.description: Publish official Windrose Steam announcements as cards or article-style posts with configurable categories and role notifications.
windrose.end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild announcement settings and bounded Steam announcement IDs. It does not persistently store user data or metadata.
windrose.install_msg: Set an announcement channel with `[p]windroseset channel #channel`, choose `[p]windroseset mode card` or `[p]windroseset mode article`, optionally set a notification role, then start automatic posting with `[p]windroseset autopost start`. Existing Steam posts are seeded during setup and will not flood the channel.
windrose.name: Windrose

wolfram.description: Query Wolfram|Alpha for answers. Requires a free API key.
wolfram.end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store data or metadata about users.
wolfram.install_msg: Set your Wolfram|Alpha AppID with `[p]set api wolfram appid,APP_ID`, then use `[p]wolfram <question>` or `[p]help Wolfram` to view available commands.
wolfram.name: Wolfram

author: SickProdigy
yugioh.description: An experimental persistent two-player Yu-Gi-Oh duel prototype with private hands, fixed beginner decks, and a deliberately bounded legacy-style rules subset.
yugioh.end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs, active duel state, private hands and decks, public actions, and channel/message identifiers. User deletion removes duels involving that user.
yugioh.install_msg: Start with [p]yugioh challenge @member. This prototype supports only its documented fixed decks and explicit rules subset.
yugioh.name: YuGiOh
